title: DocSLM: A Small Vision-Language Model for Long Multimodal Document Understanding
selection_reason: DocSLM compresses each document page into a fixed-length multimodal sequence via a Hierarchical Multimodal Compressor, reporting 82% fewer visual tokens, 75% fewer parameters and 71% lower latency for long-document VLM inference on memory-constrained edge devices.
venue: 2026 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition- FINDINGS Track (CVPRF)
